name: opencode-tool-plugin
body:
The suite's opencode 2.x tool plugins: one plugin per tool file under `opencode-suite/tools/`, each default-exporting `Plugin.define({ id, setup(ctx) })` imported from `@opencode/plugin` and registering its one tool through `ctx.tool.transform(editor => editor.add({ name, description, input, execute }))`. The definition carries the tool's name, description, a JSON-Schema `input` object, and an `execute` returning `{ content }`; the `execute` closes over the plugin `setup(ctx)` context (and the tool's own optional `directory` argument) for the shared lib's project location. The suite keeps its existing one-file-per-tool layout, so the tool file names and the shared-lib import path survive the port and the install registry stays file-shaped. Product source in `solution.container.opencode-suite`; the package dependency (`opencode-suite/package.json`) moves to `@opencode/plugin`. `implementation-by` anchors on the `ts.apg-opencode-suite` module (the graph-resolvable anchor for the whole package source, whose `tools/` files this component owns) plus the package manifest.

implemented-by: `ts.apg-opencode-suite` (module) and `opencode-suite/package.json`.
